summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing a September 18 share sale agreement to divest all equity interests in six corporate advisory and company-secretarial subsidiaries in Hong Kong and China to Ms. Chen Yanhong, a director of several targets and a 14-share holder, for aggregate cash of HK$3.5 million (about US$446,486). The audit committee approved September 8 and the board September 11; no advisor was named. Closing is expected before month-end September 2026, subject to conditions, with proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes.
